about_short_description.short_description: SimpliFi is on a mission to democratize payments by building the leading Cards as a Service (CaaS) platform for MENA and Pakistan.

product.name: Instant Card Issuance
product.description: A service to issue virtual or physical payment cards instantly for customers, employees, or partners in MENA and Pakistan.

product.name: Corporate Expense Management
product.description: A solution to control and manage corporate spending by providing employees and contractors with secure access to funds via payment cards.

product.name: Automated Corporate Payouts
product.description: A service to automate, control, and scale salary, incentive, and commission payments to employees and partners.

product.name: Consumer Spend Solutions
product.description: A platform to create custom payment experiences that generate new revenue streams and build customer loyalty.

product.name: Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) Solutions
product.description: A service to implement BNPL offerings and streamline merchant settlements to expand payment options for consumers.
